chunks: And with this chain, he raised it to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said:
There is nothing more severe for Satan than reciting the Mushaf by looking at it.

key_terms.الْمُصْحَفِ: the codex or written copy of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the most effective act to weaken Satan according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith to emphasize the tangible spiritual impact of visually engaging with the Quranic text, a practice distinct from mere memorization. In Shia tradition, this 'reading by sight' is viewed as a potent act of worship that actively diminishes Satan's influence, reinforcing the Quran's role as a divine shield against evil forces.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. And from the previous chain who raised it to The Prophet (s.a.w.s.) who said: “
There is nothing more severe for Satan except a person reciting the Holy Quran by looking at it.”
